  3. 03 Studio wireless headphones <div>
    Breadcrumb Accordion Card
    Studio wireless headphones 
    <div class="container shop">
      <nav class="breadcrumb" aria-label="Breadcrumb">
        <ol class="breadcrumb__list">
          <li class="breadcrumb__item"><a href="../website/index.html">Home</a></li>
          <li class="breadcrumb__item"><a href="index.html">Shop</a></li>
          <li class="breadcrumb__item"><a href="index.html">Audio</a></li>
          <li class="breadcrumb__item"><span aria-current="page">Studio wireless headphones</span></li>
        </ol>
      </nav>

      <div class="layout product-layout" data-layout="split">
        <section class="gallery" aria-label="Product images">
          <div class="gallery__stage">
            <img class="gallery__image gallery__image--1" src="../../assets/images/product-headphones.svg" width="400" height="300" alt="Studio wireless headphones in blue, front view" fetchpriority="high" decoding="async">
            <img class="gallery__image gallery__image--2" src="../../assets/images/product-watch.svg" width="400" height="300" alt="Headphones folded in the travel case" loading="lazy" decoding="async">
            <img class="gallery__image gallery__image--3" src="../../assets/images/product-backpack.svg" width="400" height="300" alt="Headphones stored in the commuter backpack" loading="lazy" decoding="async">
          </div>
          <fieldset class="gallery__thumbs">
            <legend class="visually-hidden">Choose an image</legend>
            <label class="gallery__thumb"><input type="radio" name="gallery" value="1" checked><img src="../../assets/images/product-headphones.svg" width="400" height="300" alt="Front view" loading="lazy" decoding="async"></label>
            <label class="gallery__thumb"><input type="radio" name="gallery" value="2"><img src="../../assets/images/product-watch.svg" width="400" height="300" alt="In the travel case" loading="lazy" decoding="async"></label>
            <label class="gallery__thumb"><input type="radio" name="gallery" value="3"><img src="../../assets/images/product-backpack.svg" width="400" height="300" alt="In the backpack" loading="lazy" decoding="async"></label>
          </fieldset>
        </section>

        <section class="stack product-info" aria-labelledby="product-title">
          <span class="badge badge--danger">Sale</span>
          <h1 id="product-title">Studio wireless headphones</h1>
          <p class="rating">
            <svg class="icon icon--filled icon--sm" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m12 2 3.09 6.26L22 9.27l-5 4.87 1.18 6.88L12 17.77l-6.18 3.25L7 14.14 2 9.27l6.91-1.01z"/></svg><svg class="icon icon--filled icon--sm" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m12 2 3.09 6.26L22 9.27l-5 4.87 1.18 6.88L12 17.77l-6.18 3.25L7 14.14 2 9.27l6.91-1.01z"/></svg><svg class="icon icon--filled icon--sm" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m12 2 3.09 6.26L22 9.27l-5 4.87 1.18 6.88L12 17.77l-6.18 3.25L7 14.14 2 9.27l6.91-1.01z"/></svg><svg class="icon icon--filled icon--sm" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m12 2 3.09 6.26L22 9.27l-5 4.87 1.18 6.88L12 17.77l-6.18 3.25L7 14.14 2 9.27l6.91-1.01z"/></svg><svg class="icon icon--filled icon--sm" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m12 2 3.09 6.26L22 9.27l-5 4.87 1.18 6.88L12 17.77l-6.18 3.25L7 14.14 2 9.27l6.91-1.01z"/></svg>
            <span class="visually-hidden">Rated 4.7 out of 5</span>
            <a class="rating__count" href="#reviews">128 reviews</a>
          </p>
          <p class="product__price product__price--lg">$179 <s><span class="visually-hidden">was </span>$229</s></p>
          <p>Studio-grade sound with adaptive noise cancelling, 40-hour battery life and a fold-flat design that fits any bag.</p>

          <form class="form" action="cart.html" method="get" data-product-form data-product-id="headphones" data-product-name="Studio wireless headphones" data-price="179" data-image="../../assets/images/product-headphones.svg">
            <fieldset class="fieldset">
              <legend class="fieldset__legend">Colour</legend>
              <div class="swatches">
                <label class="swatch"><input type="radio" name="variant" value="Indigo" checked><span class="swatch__chip swatch__chip--indigo"></span> Indigo</label>
                <label class="swatch"><input type="radio" name="variant" value="Slate"><span class="swatch__chip swatch__chip--slate"></span> Slate</label>
                <label class="swatch"><input type="radio" name="variant" value="Rose"><span class="swatch__chip swatch__chip--rose"></span> Rose</label>
              </div>
            </fieldset>
            <div class="field">
              <label class="field__label" for="product-qty">Quantity</label>
              <div class="stepper">
                <button type="button" class="btn btn--secondary btn--icon" data-step="-1" hidden><svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 12h14"/></svg><span class="visually-hidden">Decrease quantity</span></button>
                <input class="input stepper__input" id="product-qty" name="qty" type="number" inputmode="numeric" min="1" max="10" value="1">
                <button type="button" class="btn btn--secondary btn--icon" data-step="1" hidden><svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 5v14M5 12h14"/></svg><span class="visually-hidden">Increase quantity</span></button>
              </div>
            </div>
            <div class="cluster">
              <button type="submit" class="btn btn--lg"><svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="9" cy="20" r="1.5"/><circle cx="18" cy="20" r="1.5"/><path d="M2 3h3l2.4 12.2a2 2 0 0 0 2 1.6h8.2a2 2 0 0 0 2-1.6L21 7H6"/></svg> Add to cart</button>
              <a class="btn btn--lg btn--secondary" href="cart.html">View cart</a>
            </div>
          </form>

          <ul class="perks-inline list-reset" role="list">
            <li><svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M1 3h15v13H1zM16 8h4l3 3v5h-7z"/><circle cx="5.5" cy="18.5" r="2.5"/><circle cx="18.5" cy="18.5" r="2.5"/></svg> Free shipping, arrives in 2–4 days</li>
            <li><svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M23 4v6h-6M1 20v-6h6"/><path d="M3.51 9a9 9 0 0 1 14.85-3.36L23 10M1 14l4.64 4.36A9 9 0 0 0 20.49 15"/></svg> 30-day returns</li>
            <li><svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M12 22s8-4 8-10V5l-8-3-8 3v7c0 6 8 10 8 10z"/></svg> 2-year warranty</li>
          </ul>

          <div class="accordion">
            <details class="accordion__item" open>
              <summary class="accordion__summary">Specifications <svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"/></svg></summary>
              <div class="accordion__panel">
                <dl class="details-list">
                  <div><dt>Battery</dt><dd>40 hours (ANC on)</dd></div>
                  <div><dt>Weight</dt><dd>254 g</dd></div>
                  <div><dt>Connectivity</dt><dd>Bluetooth 5.4, USB-C audio</dd></div>
                  <div><dt>Charging</dt><dd>10 minutes for 5 hours</dd></div>
                </dl>
              </div>
            </details>
            <details class="accordion__item">
              <summary class="accordion__summary">Shipping and returns <svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m6 9 6 6 6-6"/></svg></summary>
              <div class="accordion__panel"><p>Free standard shipping on orders over $50. Return within 30 days for a full refund.</p></div>
            </details>
          </div>
        </section>
      </div>

      <section class="reviews" id="reviews" aria-labelledby="reviews-title">
        <h2 id="reviews-title">Customer reviews</h2>
        <div class="layout reviews__layout" data-layout="sidebar-left">
          <div class="layout__sidebar">
            <script type="application/json" id="review-data">[{"stars": "5 stars", "reviews": 92}, {"stars": "4 stars", "reviews": 24}, {"stars": "3 stars", "reviews": 7}, {"stars": "2 stars", "reviews": 3}, {"stars": "1 star", "reviews": 2}]</script>
            <figure class="chart" data-viz="hbar" data-source="#review-data" data-x="stars" data-series="reviews:Reviews:5" data-format="integer">
              <figcaption class="chart__caption"><span class="chart__title">4.7 out of 5</span><span class="chart__subtitle">128 reviews</span></figcaption>
              <p class="chart__fallback">92 five-star, 24 four-star, 7 three-star, 3 two-star and 2 one-star reviews.</p>
            </figure>
          </div>
          <ul class="review-list list-reset" role="list">
            <li class="card card--flat"><div class="card__body"><p class="rating"><svg class="icon icon--filled icon--sm" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m12 2 3.09 6.26L22 9.27l-5 4.87 1.18 6.88L12 17.77l-6.18 3.25L7 14.14 2 9.27l6.91-1.01z"/></svg><svg class="icon icon--filled icon--sm" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m12 2 3.09 6.26L22 9.27l-5 4.87 1.18 6.88L12 17.77l-6.18 3.25L7 14.14 2 9.27l6.91-1.01z"/></svg><svg class="icon icon--filled icon--sm" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m12 2 3.09 6.26L22 9.27l-5 4.87 1.18 6.88L12 17.77l-6.18 3.25L7 14.14 2 9.27l6.91-1.01z"/></svg><svg class="icon icon--filled icon--sm" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m12 2 3.09 6.26L22 9.27l-5 4.87 1.18 6.88L12 17.77l-6.18 3.25L7 14.14 2 9.27l6.91-1.01z"/></svg><svg class="icon icon--filled icon--sm" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m12 2 3.09 6.26L22 9.27l-5 4.87 1.18 6.88L12 17.77l-6.18 3.25L7 14.14 2 9.27l6.91-1.01z"/></svg><span class="visually-hidden">5 out of 5</span></p><h3 class="card__title">Best headphones I have owned</h3><p class="card__text">Noise cancelling is superb on flights and the battery lasts all week.</p><p class="text-sm text-muted">Kenji T. · <time datetime="2026-09-28">28 Sep 2026</time> · Verified purchase</p></div></li>
            <li class="card card--flat"><div class="card__body"><p class="rating"><svg class="icon icon--filled icon--sm" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m12 2 3.09 6.26L22 9.27l-5 4.87 1.18 6.88L12 17.77l-6.18 3.25L7 14.14 2 9.27l6.91-1.01z"/></svg><svg class="icon icon--filled icon--sm" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m12 2 3.09 6.26L22 9.27l-5 4.87 1.18 6.88L12 17.77l-6.18 3.25L7 14.14 2 9.27l6.91-1.01z"/></svg><svg class="icon icon--filled icon--sm" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m12 2 3.09 6.26L22 9.27l-5 4.87 1.18 6.88L12 17.77l-6.18 3.25L7 14.14 2 9.27l6.91-1.01z"/></svg><svg class="icon icon--filled icon--sm" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m12 2 3.09 6.26L22 9.27l-5 4.87 1.18 6.88L12 17.77l-6.18 3.25L7 14.14 2 9.27l6.91-1.01z"/></svg><svg class="icon icon--filled icon--sm rating__empty" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="m12 2 3.09 6.26L22 9.27l-5 4.87 1.18 6.88L12 17.77l-6.18 3.25L7 14.14 2 9.27l6.91-1.01z"/></svg><span class="visually-hidden">4 out of 5</span></p><h3 class="card__title">Great sound, snug fit</h3><p class="card__text">Excellent clarity. A little tight at first but it eased after a week.</p><p class="text-sm text-muted">Ana S. · <time datetime="2026-09-12">12 Sep 2026</time> · Verified purchase</p></div></li>
          </ul>

  5. 05 Chat widget Shared partial
    src/layouts/partials/chat-widget.html
    Chat widget 
    <!-- Floating support assistant. Needs components/chat.css + main.js. -->
<div class="chat-widget" data-chat-widget>
  <button type="button" class="btn chat-widget__launcher" aria-expanded="false" aria-controls="chat-widget-panel" data-chat-launcher hidden>
    <svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M21 15a2 2 0 0 1-2 2H7l-4 4V5a2 2 0 0 1 2-2h14a2 2 0 0 1 2 2z"/></svg>
    <span>Ask Acme AI</span>
  </button>
  <div class="chat-widget__panel" id="chat-widget-panel" role="dialog" aria-labelledby="chat-widget-title" hidden>
    <section class="chat chat--widget" data-chat data-chat-persona="support" data-chat-storage="vr-chat-support">
      <header class="chat__header">
        <span class="avatar avatar--soft"><svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="3" y="8" width="18" height="12" rx="3"/><path d="M12 8V4M8 2h8M9 13v2M15 13v2"/></svg></span>
        <div class="chat__heading">
          <h2 class="chat__title" id="chat-widget-title">Acme AI support</h2>
          <p class="chat__status">Usually replies instantly</p>
        </div>
        <button type="button" class="btn btn--ghost btn--icon btn--sm" data-chat-clear hidden>
          <svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M23 4v6h-6M1 20v-6h6"/><path d="M3.51 9a9 9 0 0 1 14.85-3.36L23 10M1 14l4.64 4.36A9 9 0 0 0 20.49 15"/></svg>
          <span class="visually-hidden">Start a new conversation</span>
        </button>
        <button type="button" class="btn btn--ghost btn--icon btn--sm" data-chat-close>
          <svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 12h14"/></svg>
          <span class="visually-hidden">Minimise chat</span>
        </button>
      </header>
      <div class="chat__log" role="log" aria-label="Conversation with Acme AI support" aria-live="off" tabindex="0" data-chat-log>
        <div class="chat__message chat__message--assistant">
          <div class="chat__bubble">
            <p>Hi! I can track orders, explain returns and shipping, or connect you with a person. What can I help with?</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div class="chat__suggestions" data-chat-suggestions hidden>
        <button type="button" class="chip" data-chat-suggestion>Where is my order #1061?</button>
        <button type="button" class="chip" data-chat-suggestion>What is your return policy?</button>
        <button type="button" class="chip" data-chat-suggestion>Talk to a person</button>
      </div>
      <form class="chat__composer" action="../../templates/website/contact.html" method="get" data-chat-form>
        <label class="visually-hidden" for="chat-widget-input">Message Acme AI support</label>
        <textarea class="chat__input" id="chat-widget-input" name="message" rows="1" placeholder="Ask a question…" required data-chat-input></textarea>
        <div class="chat__actions">
          <button type="submit" class="btn btn--icon btn--sm" data-chat-send>
            <svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M22 2 11 13"/><path d="M22 2 15 22l-4-9-9-4z"/></svg>
            <span class="visually-hidden">Send message</span>
          </button>
          <button type="button" class="btn btn--icon btn--sm btn--secondary" data-chat-stop hidden>
            <svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><rect x="6" y="6" width="12" height="12" rx="2"/></svg>
            <span class="visually-hidden">Stop generating</span>
          </button>
        </div>
      </form>
      <p class="chat__disclaimer">Demo assistant with sample data. Answers may be inaccurate.</p>
    </section>
  </div>
</div>

    Theme panel 
    <dialog class="dialog drawer" id="theme-panel" aria-labelledby="theme-panel-title" closedby="any">
  <div class="dialog__header">
    <h2 class="dialog__title" id="theme-panel-title">Customize theme</h2>
    <button type="button" class="btn btn--ghost btn--icon" commandfor="theme-panel" command="close">
      <svg class="icon" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M18 6 6 18M6 6l12 12"/></svg>
      <span class="visually-hidden">Close theme panel</span>
    </button>
  </div>
  <form class="dialog__body form" data-theme-customizer>
    <fieldset class="fieldset">
      <legend class="fieldset__legend">Mode</legend>
      <div class="segmented">
        <label class="segmented__option"><input type="radio" name="mode" value="system"><span class="segmented__label">System</span></label>
        <label class="segmented__option"><input type="radio" name="mode" value="light"><span class="segmented__label"><svg class="icon icon--sm" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><circle cx="12" cy="12" r="4"/><path d="M12 2v2M12 20v2M4.93 4.93l1.41 1.41M17.66 17.66l1.41 1.41M2 12h2M20 12h2M6.34 17.66l-1.41 1.41M19.07 4.93l-1.41 1.41"/></svg> Light</span></label>
        <label class="segmented__option"><input type="radio" name="mode" value="dark"><span class="segmented__label"><svg class="icon icon--sm" viewBox="0 0 24 24" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M21 12.79A9 9 0 1 1 11.21 3 7 7 0 0 0 21 12.79z"/></svg> Dark</span></label>
      </div>
    </fieldset>

    <fieldset class="fieldset">
      <legend class="fieldset__legend">Brand colour</legend>
      <div class="swatches">
        <label class="swatch"><input type="radio" name="brand" value="indigo"><span class="swatch__chip swatch__chip--indigo"></span> Indigo</label>
        <label class="swatch"><input type="radio" name="brand" value="teal"><span class="swatch__chip swatch__chip--teal"></span> Teal</label>
        <label class="swatch"><input type="radio" name="brand" value="violet"><span class="swatch__chip swatch__chip--violet"></span> Violet</label>
        <label class="swatch"><input type="radio" name="brand" value="rose"><span class="swatch__chip swatch__chip--rose"></span> Rose</label>
        <label class="swatch"><input type="radio" name="brand" value="amber"><span class="swatch__chip swatch__chip--amber"></span> Amber</label>
        <label class="swatch"><input type="radio" name="brand" value="slate"><span class="swatch__chip swatch__chip--slate"></span> Slate</label>
      </div>
    </fieldset>

    <div class="field">
      <label class="field__label" for="theme-custom-color">Or pick any brand colour</label>
      <p class="field__hint" id="theme-custom-hint">Shades are adjusted automatically to keep text readable in both themes.</p>
      <input class="color-input" id="theme-custom-color" name="custom" type="color" value="#2a4fcf" aria-describedby="theme-custom-hint">
    </div>

    <p class="text-sm text-muted" role="status" data-theme-contrast></p>

    <fieldset class="fieldset">
      <legend class="fieldset__legend">Density</legend>
      <div class="segmented">
        <label class="segmented__option"><input type="radio" name="density" value="compact"><span class="segmented__label">Compact</span></label>
        <label class="segmented__option"><input type="radio" name="density" value="default"><span class="segmented__label">Default</span></label>
        <label class="segmented__option"><input type="radio" name="density" value="comfortable"><span class="segmented__label">Comfortable</span></label>
      </div>
    </fieldset>

    <fieldset class="fieldset">
      <legend class="fieldset__legend">Corners</legend>
      <div class="segmented">
        <label class="segmented__option"><input type="radio" name="radius" value="sharp"><span class="segmented__label">Sharp</span></label>
        <label class="segmented__option"><input type="radio" name="radius" value="default"><span class="segmented__label">Default</span></label>
        <label class="segmented__option"><input type="radio" name="radius" value="round"><span class="segmented__label">Round</span></label>
      </div>
    </fieldset>

    <div class="field">
      <label class="field__label" for="theme-css-output">CSS for your project</label>
      <textarea class="textarea textarea--code" id="theme-css-output" readonly rows="8" data-theme-output></textarea>
    </div>

    <div class="form-actions">
      <button type="button" class="btn btn--sm" data-copy data-copy-target="#theme-css-output" hidden><span data-copy-label>Copy CSS</span></button>
      <button type="button" class="btn btn--sm btn--ghost" data-theme-reset>Reset to defaults</button>
    </div>
  </form>
</dialog>
